entries.title: Job 4:1
segments: ¶Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:

entries.title: Job 4:2
segments: "[If] one attempts a word with you, will you become weary? But who can withhold himself from speaking?

entries.title: Job 4:3
segments: Surely you have instructed many, And you have strengthened weak hands.

entries.title: Job 4:4
segments: Your words have upheld him who was stumbling, And you have strengthened the feeble knees;

entries.title: Job 4:5
segments: But now it comes upon you, and you are weary; It touches you, and you are troubled.

entries.title: Job 4:6
segments: [Is] not your reverence your confidence? And the integrity of your ways your hope?

entries.title: Job 4:7
segments: ¶"Remember now, who [ever] perished being innocent? Or where were the upright [ever] cut off?

entries.title: Job 4:8
segments: Even as I have seen, Those who plow iniquity And sow trouble reap the same.

entries.title: Job 4:9
segments: By the blast of God they perish, And by the breath of His anger they are consumed.

entries.title: Job 4:10
segments: The roaring of the lion, The voice of the fierce lion, And the teeth of the young lions are broken.

entries.title: Job 4:11
segments: The old lion perishes for lack of prey, And the cubs of the lioness are scattered.

entries.title: Job 4:12
segments: ¶"Now a word was secretly brought to me, And my ear received a whisper of it.

entries.title: Job 4:13
segments: In disquieting thoughts from the visions of the night, When deep sleep falls on men,

entries.title: Job 4:14
segments: Fear came upon me, and trembling, Which made all my bones shake.

entries.title: Job 4:15
segments: Then a spirit passed before my face; The hair on my body stood up.

entries.title: Job 4:16
segments: It stood still, But I could not discern its appearance. A form [was] before my eyes; [There was] silence; Then I heard a voice [saying]:

entries.title: Job 4:17
segments: 'Can a mortal be more righteous than God? Can a man be more pure than his Maker?

entries.title: Job 4:18
segments: If He puts no trust in His servants, [If] He charges His angels with error,

entries.title: Job 4:19
segments: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, Whose foundation is in the dust, [Who] are crushed before a moth?

entries.title: Job 4:20
segments: They are broken in pieces from morning till evening; They perish forever, with no one regarding.

entries.title: Job 4:21
segments: Does not their own excellence go away? They die, even without wisdom.'
